entries.title: Job 9:1
segments: ¶Then Job answered and said:

entries.title: Job 9:2
segments: "Truly I know [it is] so, But how can a man be righteous before God?

entries.title: Job 9:3
segments: If one wished to contend with Him, He could not answer Him one time out of a thousand.

entries.title: Job 9:4
segments: God [is] wise in heart and mighty in strength. Who has hardened [himself] against Him and prospered?

entries.title: Job 9:5
segments: He removes the mountains, and they do not know When He overturns them in His anger;

entries.title: Job 9:6
segments: He shakes the earth out of its place, And its pillars tremble;

entries.title: Job 9:7
segments: He commands the sun, and it does not rise; He seals off the stars;

entries.title: Job 9:8
segments: He alone spreads out the heavens, And treads on the waves of the sea;

entries.title: Job 9:9
segments: He made the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, And the chambers of the south;

entries.title: Job 9:10
segments: He does great things past finding out, Yes, wonders without number.

entries.title: Job 9:11
segments: If He goes by me, I do not see [Him]; If He moves past, I do not perceive Him;

entries.title: Job 9:12
segments: If He takes away, who can hinder Him? Who can say to Him, 'What are You doing?'

entries.title: Job 9:13
segments: God will not withdraw His anger, The allies of the proud lie prostrate beneath Him.

entries.title: Job 9:14
segments: ¶"How then can I answer Him, [And] choose my words [to reason] with Him?

entries.title: Job 9:15
segments: For though I were righteous, I could not answer Him; I would beg mercy of my Judge.

entries.title: Job 9:16
segments: If I called and He answered me, I would not believe that He was listening to my voice.

entries.title: Job 9:17
segments: For He crushes me with a tempest, And multiplies my wounds without cause.

entries.title: Job 9:18
segments: He will not allow me to catch my breath, But fills me with bitterness.

entries.title: Job 9:19
segments: If [it is a matter] of strength, indeed [He is] strong; And if of justice, who will appoint my day [in court]?

entries.title: Job 9:20
segments: Though I were righteous, my own mouth would condemn me; Though I [were] blameless, it would prove me perverse.

entries.title: Job 9:21
segments: "I am blameless, yet I do not know myself; I despise my life.

entries.title: Job 9:22
segments: ¶It [is] all one [thing]; Therefore I say, 'He destroys the blameless and the wicked.'

entries.title: Job 9:23
segments: If the scourge slays suddenly, He laughs at the plight of the innocent.

entries.title: Job 9:24
segments: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If it is not [He], who else could it be?

entries.title: Job 9:25
segments: ¶"Now my days are swifter than a runner; They flee away, they see no good.

entries.title: Job 9:26
segments: They pass by like swift ships, Like an eagle swooping on its prey.

entries.title: Job 9:27
segments: If I say, 'I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face and wear a smile,'

entries.title: Job 9:28
segments: I am afraid of all my sufferings; I know that You will not hold me innocent.

entries.title: Job 9:29
segments: [If] I am condemned, Why then do I labor in vain?

entries.title: Job 9:30
segments: If I wash myself with snow water, And cleanse my hands with soap,

entries.title: Job 9:31
segments: Yet You will plunge me into the pit, And my own clothes will abhor me.

entries.title: Job 9:32
segments: "For [He is] not a man, as I [am, That] I may answer Him, [And that] we should go to court together.

entries.title: Job 9:33
segments: Nor is there any mediator between us, [Who] may lay his hand on us both.

entries.title: Job 9:34
segments: Let Him take His rod away from me, And do not let dread of Him terrify me.

entries.title: Job 9:35
segments: [Then] I would speak and not fear Him, But it is not so with me.
